call_points.text: Lactic plant commissioning expected in October and PLA in December 2026.
About ₹2,180 Cr spent on the PLA project by end-July 2026.
Pan masala and gutka packaging shift to PLA could largely absorb the entire capacity, management said.
Technical trials for PLA in pan masala packaging were successful; results expected in two to three months.
Distillery margins held up because the quarter used largely B-heavy and maize feedstock, with hardly any juice-based ethanol sales.
Maizapur distillery expenditure was retained in the sugar division this quarter, so segment margins are not comparable year on year.
Assumes no B-heavy or juice diversion next season, only C-heavy ethanol; volume numbers being reworked.
Expects a sugarcane price hike next season but sees higher sugar realisations outweighing it net-net.
Carried sugar inventory of 45.67 lakh quintals at INR 37.19 per kg as of June 30.
Rainfall in its command area has been ideal for cane; area may be flat but yields look better.
Declined to give country sugar production, consumption or closing stock estimates, citing conflicting numbers.
Said market closing stock may be 35 lakh tonnes versus the 30 lakh tonnes the market assumes.
Whether PLA qualifies under the new pan masala packaging rule is still being clarified; answer was yes and no.
PLA plant commissioning remains on track for the third quarter of FY27.
Management expects positive movement on ethanol pricing given broader macroeconomic cost escalations.
PLA project cost revised upward by ₹230 crore to ₹3,080 crore due to forex and supply chain pressures.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had received an assessment order amounting to Rs. 35,20,98,430/- under section 143(3) of Income Tax Act, 1961, pertaining to AY 2022-23, wherein certain disallowances have been affected by the Assessing Officer. Further, a rectification order under section 154 read with section 143(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 had been passed by the Office of the Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax on 2nd May, 2025 wherein the aforesaid demand had been deleted/adjusted by the said authority. However, an Appeal was filed for the demand raised by the Assessing Officer in the assessment order amounting to Rs. 35,20,98,430/-. The same was pending before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).
tax_litigation.status: The Appeal is still pending before Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Consequent to Hon’ble Supreme Court’s Order dated 23rd October 2024 vide which it had upheld the State’s authority to levy import/export fees on denatured alcohol, the Excise Department of Uttar Pradesh had reinstated import/export fees on denatured alcohol by revoking its earlier Order of 2018 which had suspended import/export fees on denatured alcohol. Accordingly, the Assistant Excise Commissioner of Uttar Pradesh had imposed charges retrospectively, covering the period from FY 2019-2020 upto 15.07.2025. The Company had stated that it will be going through appropriate forums for evaluating legal recourse to be taken in the above-mentioned matter. Further, the Uttar Pradesh Sugar Mills Association (UPSMA) has filed a writ petition before the Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Allahabad against the aforesaid matter, which is currently pending adjudication.
tax_litigation.status: The Writ Petition filed before the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad is still pending before the court.

operating_notes.text: PLA project capital outlay revised to ₹3,080 Cr including ₹230 Cr cost escalations.
Approved establishment of a Lactogypsum Processing Plant at Kumbhi, UP, for up to ₹160 Cr.
PLA project cost revised to ₹3,080 crore due to a ₹230 crore overrun.
Sugar Season 2025-26 concluded with 104.30 lac MT sugarcane crushed and 9.68 lac MT sugar produced.
Government institution study confirms PLA microplastics break down from 287 to 18 particles/kg within 180 days in Indian soil.
Q4FY26 sugarcane crushing reached ~622.2 lac qtls (+1.6% YoY) with gross sugar recovery at 11.59%.
Launched 'Building Skills. Transforming Futures – Balrampur Bioyug Bioplastic 3D Printing Project' at ITI Mohammadi for women students.
PLA plant commissioning is targeted for the third quarter of FY27.
BCML is setting up India's first Poly Lactic Acid (PLA) plant of 80000 TPA capacity.
Sugar inventory was 45.67 lakh quintals at an average carrying cost of INR 37.19 per kg as of June 30, 2026.
About ₹2,180 Cr had been spent on the 80,000-tonne PLA project by end-July 2026.
Management said market closing stock may be 35 lakh tonnes versus the 30 lakh tonnes the market assumes.

timeline.summary: Balrampur Chini Mills approved a ₹450 Cr preferential issue, ₹200 Cr NCD issuance, a PLA project capex revision to ₹3,080 Cr, and a new ₹160 Cr gypsum plant.
On April 28, 2026, Balrampur Chini Mills hosted an earnings call detailing a ₹230 crore cost overrun for its PLA project, a ₹160 crore lactogypsum plant, and a ₹450 crore preferential fundraise.
Balrampur Chini reported operational data for Sugar Season 2025-26, crushing 104.30 lac MT of sugarcane.
Balrampur Chini highlighted a government institution study confirming PLA bioplastics degrade safely in Indian soil.
Balrampur Chini Mills announced credit rating affirmations from India Ratings for its commercial paper and term loan facilities on May 13, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,603.99 Cr (+6.7% YoY), net profit ₹159.57 Cr (-30.4% YoY).
On May 15, 2026, Balrampur Chini Mills reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,604 Cr (+6.7% YoY) and TCI of ₹157 Cr (-30.3% YoY), alongside a ₹450 Cr preferential issue.
Balrampur Chini Mills uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 18, 2026.
Balrampur Chini Mills launched a women-focused 3D printing skill development project at ITI Mohammadi in collaboration with Balrampur Bioyug.
Balrampur Chini Mills announced EGM voting results approving the preferential equity issue on May 21, 2026.
Balrampur Chini Mills held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 18, 2026, discussing PLA commissioning timelines and ethanol price revision expectations.
Balrampur Chini Mills allotted 93.17 lakh equity shares via preferential issue raising ₹450 crore.
Balrampur Chini Mills launched the 'Bioyug Green Command 2026' bioplastics adoption initiative with the Lucknow Cantonment Board.

On its 12 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Balrampur Chini said it had spent about ₹2,180 Cr on its PLA project by end-July, expects lactic commissioning in October and PLA in December 2026, and targets around 40% average utilisation from January to March 2027.
